pages.scene_description: Opening splash page. Dawn breaks over a misty Japanese mountain village. Riku stands on a cliff edge, katana drawn, wind whipping her crimson hair.

panels.description: Epic wide shot of Riku silhouetted against a blood-red sunrise on a cliff overlooking a misty mountain village, katana raised, crimson hair flowing in the wind

text_overlays.text: In a world where demons walk among mortals, one girl stands between darkness and dawn.

pages.scene_description: Riku walks through the village marketplace. Villagers whisper about demon sightings in the northern forest.

panels.description: Riku walking through a bustling village marketplace, morning light, merchants and villagers around her, she looks determined

text_overlays.text: The village of Akiyama — three days since the last attack.

panels.description: Close-up of two elderly villagers whispering to each other with worried expressions, market stall in background
panels.dialogue: They say the northern forest has gone silent... not even the birds sing anymore.

text_overlays.text: They say the northern forest has gone silent... not even the birds sing anymore.

panels.description: Riku pausing mid-step, her golden eyes narrowing, hand instinctively reaching for her katana hilt
Over-the-shoulder shot of Riku looking toward dark treeline of the northern forest in the distance, ominous dark clouds gathering

pages.scene_description: Riku enters the forest. The atmosphere shifts — dark, twisted trees, glowing eyes in shadows. She draws her katana.

panels.description: Wide shot of Riku entering a dark twisted forest, gnarled trees forming an ominous canopy, shafts of dim light breaking through
Close-up of Riku's boots stepping on cracked dead leaves, the ground is scorched and blackened
Extreme close-up of glowing red eyes watching from the shadows between twisted tree trunks
Medium shot of Riku sensing danger, her golden eyes wide, hand gripping katana hilt tightly
Dynamic action shot of Riku drawing her katana in a flash of silver light, battle stance, crimson hair swept back by the force
